title: The needs-you button becomes an inbox
text: The "need you" button in the bar now slides out an inbox instead of jumping to a single card. It lists everything that waits for you across all canvases, each entry with its canvas, the card's title and the question. One-click buttons such as Approve answer an entry without opening the card, and Go to card is always there as a plain secondary button.
chapters: The button slides out an inbox
